scope: Explicit tolerant extraction, separate from strict JSON compliance. Descriptive lexical metrics are not basin identification.
extraction_method: Reuse extract_passages.extract(): a whole JSON object, optionally enclosed in one full Markdown fence; try strict JSON first, then allow literal control characters. No quote repair or free-text story extraction.

definitions.completed_hops: Normal provider finish, nonempty visible output, known usage estimate, no recorded exception.
definitions.full_visible_recurrence: Every completed response in full, including JSON wrappers, rule text, and non-JSON outcomes.
definitions.extracted_text_recurrence: Every extracted string text, including empty strings or changed/missing rules; wrappers and rule fields excluded.
definitions.rule_survival: Measured only when the extractor returns a text-bearing object; otherwise unassessable, not assumed absent.
definitions.normalized_recurrence: Unicode casefold and whitespace collapsing; punctuation retained.
definitions.pending: Request-only outcomes/billing remain unresolved and are not API or model failures.
definitions.noncompleted: Receipt outcome categories retained from the audit; operational errors are not evidence of model behavior.

lexical.description: Descriptive lexical similarity; not semantic basin identification or an inferential test.
lexical.tail_selection: Last 20 completed hops per stream first; then exclude unextractable, empty, or changed/missing-rule passages. Never backfill. Every source receipt passed the independent integrity audit.
lexical.representation: Only explicitly extracted text fields; optional full Markdown fence removal and json.loads(strict=False) allow literal control characters. Rule and other fields are excluded.
lexical.tokenization: ASCII [a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?, lowercased, minimum length 2; no stemming.
lexical.weighting: Raw term count times log((1+N)/(1+df))+1; L2-normalized per passage.
lexical.centroid: L2-normalized sum of nonzero passage vectors per stream; cosine matrix in CSV.
lexical.empty_centroid_policy: CSV cell blank if either stream has no nonzero passage vectors.
